findings.body:
chunk 1/6:

The required acceptance test is missing. The branch's only test change removes a scan root from `browser-legacy-cleanup.test.ts`; it does not exercise Forge or verify this cleanup. The repository suites contain no Forge acceptance test covering the revised roadmap and removal of migration artifacts. Add a suite-wired test through the real Forge CLI that verifies the cleaned repository remains usable and detects restoration of the obsolete roadmap entries or migration artifacts, as required by the test-audit contract.

why: After the move to Forge v1, myclaw still carries the old Forge's leftovers: dead records, drafts, rules and docs that describe the old harness
